The identity

01 / Logo system

A bold, geometric elephant head expresses resilience and self-command. The central line evokes an inner axis, a north star, and direction. The two-tone treatment is deliberately restrained so the emblem reads at a glance, even on the smallest app surfaces.

Signature palette

02 / Color strategy

Forest and bronze define the identity. Olive is a secondary strategic surface, sage softens the system, and ivory brings calm and legibility. Prefer ivory for paragraphs over bronze to maintain clear contrast.

Brand discipline

08 / Usage rules

Do

Protect clear space around the mark. Keep it one or two flat colors. Use antique bronze for identity and ivory for legible small text. Prefer calm editorial imagery and reflective messaging. Check 32px recognition.

Don't

Don't use guns, weapons, camouflage, or aggressive military scenes. Don't add ornate borders or gradients to the emblem. Don't stretch the wordmark, place it over busy imagery, or turn progress into a judgment of personal worth.
